decision.reasoning_trace: The browsing session for backpacks included many non-backpack items such as lanterns, chairs, and cookware. I filtered for actual wearable backpacks. The KAILAS 28L (prod_backpacks_043) was selected for consideration because it offered high-end technical features like a carbon fiber frame and was compared favorably to Osprey. The ZOMAKE (prod_backpacks_099) was included as a top-rated budget option. The Warriors tactical pack (prod_backpacks_064) provided a rugged alternative, while the TOURIT (prod_backpacks_154) and TOMSHOO (prod_backpacks_073) served niche cooler and cycling needs respectively. I ultimately chose the KAILAS because of its high rating, 28L capacity suitable for day-hiking, and the included rain cover, which provided the best balance of quality and utility for a serious outdoor user.
